fixedPrompt: Add a search filter to the main list endpoint — the GET route that returns the collection of the signed-in user's items. Support an optional `q` query parameter so that a request like `GET /<resource>?q=<term>` returns only the items whose text fields contain `<term>`, matched case-insensitively. When `q` is absent or empty, the endpoint behaves exactly as before.
